title: MaterialsScience NanoparticleSynthSOP

stats.done_summary: Successfully converted raw lab notes from 'data/lab_scratch.txt' into an executable SOP 'nanoparticle_sop.md' for pilot-scale copper nanoparticle synthesis. Developed comprehensive analysis code 'code/sop_analysis.py' that generates scaling calculations, temperature profiles, UV-Vis simulations, and process visualizations. Created 5 figures for the report and delivered a complete research report 'report/report.md' documenting methodology, results, and discussion. All deliverables meet the requirements for formalizing bench notes into a pilot-scale synthesis procedure.
